title: Morning Market Update
prompt: Use my installed market-update skill to run the previous-day US market workflow for yesterday in Asia/Hong_Kong. Produce separate English and Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans, not Traditional Chinese) images from the same verified snapshot. Follow references/languages.md to cache and verify Chinese fonts, start a fresh run with scripts/workflow.py init --languages en,zh-Hans --chinese-font-dir <verified-font-directory>, and follow references/workflow.md, pausing for authenticated Massive retrieval and verified research as needed. Preserve all required market, risk/sentiment, news and next-session HKT coverage, approved editorial typography and dreamy image design. Resolve validation warnings, complete and verify the hash-bound Simplified Chinese translation, inspect both languages at full size and preview size, save and display both PNGs with a 60–100 word English accessible summary, a concise Simplified Chinese equivalent and real source links, and record actual review/delivery evidence for both image hashes and delivery references. Report unavailable data or delivery limitations honestly. Never reuse fixtures, illustrative values or an earlier briefing; do not invent facts or trading recommendations.
